# Jubilees Chapter 2 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** Creation and the Sabbath

---

**2:1** The angel of the presence delivered God's message to Moses: "Write down the complete story of creation — how in six days the LORD God completed all his work, then rested on the seventh day, declared it holy for all time, and set it apart as a sign pointing to everything he had made."

**2:2** "On the first day he created the upper heavens, the earth, the waters, and all the angelic spirits that serve before him: the angels of the presence, the angels of holiness, the angels governing fire and wind, the angels of cloud, of darkness, of snow, of hail, of frost, the angels of sound, thunder, and lightning, and the angels of cold and heat, of every season — winter, spring, summer, autumn — all the spirits of his creation, above and below."

**2:3** "He created the deep and darkness, evening and night — and then the light: dawn, and day, all of it prepared in his own mind before anything existed."

**2:4** "When we angels saw what he had made, we praised him and sang his glory. He had made seven great works in that single day."

**2:5** "On the second day he made the sky — a great dome set in the middle of the waters. Half the water rose above the dome, half stayed below it beneath the face of all the earth. That was the only work done on day two."

**2:6** "On the third day he ordered the waters to pull back from every surface of the earth into one gathered place, and the dry land to emerge."

**2:7** "The waters obeyed and retreated to their basin outside the dome, and the land appeared."

**2:8** "That same day he made every sea in its proper boundary, every river, every mountain spring, every lake, every drop of dew. He made seeds and sprouting things, orchards and forests, and the garden of Eden itself — every plant by its kind."

**2:9** "Four great works on day three."

**2:10** "On the fourth day he made the sun, the moon, and the stars, and set them in the sky to light the whole earth and to govern the rhythm of day and night, separating light from darkness."

**2:11** "He appointed the sun as the master clock for all time — for daily reckoning, for sabbaths, for months, for festivals, for years, for sabbatical years, for jubilees, for every division of the calendar."

**2:12** "The sun divides light from darkness and drives the growth of everything alive on the earth. Three works on day four."

**2:13** "On the fifth day he made the great sea creatures deep in the ocean — the first living flesh his hands ever formed — along with the fish and every creature moving through water, and all the flying things, every kind of bird."

**2:14** "The sun warmed them all: the creatures of sea and sky, the plants springing up from the earth, the fruit trees, all living things. Three works on day five."

**2:15** "On the sixth day he made all the wild animals, the livestock, and every creature that creeps and moves across the earth."

**2:16** "Last of all, he made human beings — male and female together — and gave them authority over everything: the creatures of sea, sky, and land, all animals and livestock, every moving thing, the whole earth. He gave them rule over all four realms."

**2:17** "Three works on day six."

**2:18** "Twenty-two kinds of creation in all."

**2:19** "On the sixth day he finished everything — heaven, earth, sea, the deep below, light, darkness, all of it. And then he gave us the greatest sign of all: the sabbath. Six days of work, and on the seventh, complete rest."

**2:20** "The two highest angelic orders — the angels of the presence and the angels of holiness — he commanded to keep sabbath with him, both in heaven and on earth."

**2:21** "He said to us: 'I am going to set apart one people from all the peoples of the earth. They will keep the sabbath, and I will make them holy as my own people, and I will bless them — just as I have kept the sabbath holy, I will bless them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.'"

**2:22** "I chose Jacob's family above all others I had seen, and I wrote him down as my firstborn son, set apart as mine forever. I would teach them about sabbath days and how to rest from all work."

**2:23** "So he gave them a sign: keep sabbath with us on the seventh day — eat, drink, bless the Creator — just as he blessed and consecrated a special people above all others, so they could keep sabbath with us."

**2:24** "Their worship rose before him like sweet incense, pleasing to him every single day."

**2:25** "There are twenty-two human ancestors from Adam to Jacob, and twenty-two categories of creation completed by the seventh day. That day is blessed and holy — and so is the whole pattern. Both are given for blessing and holiness."

**2:26** "Jacob and his descendants were given the privilege of being always the blessed and holy people of the first covenant and law, just as God sanctified and blessed the seventh day."

**2:27** "He made heaven and earth and everything in six days, and made the seventh day holy above all his works. Because of that, he decreed: whoever works on that day must die; whoever defiles it will surely die."

**2:28** "So command the Israelites to keep this day holy — no work, no defilement — because it is holier than any other day."

**2:29** "Anyone who defiles it dies. Anyone who works on it dies forever. Israel must guard this day through every generation, or they will be torn up from the land. It is a holy day, a blessed day."

**2:30** "And anyone who truly keeps it — resting from all work — will be holy and blessed forever, just as we are."

**2:31** "Tell Israel the law of the sabbath: keep it, do not abandon it out of some confused idea. You cannot do ordinary work on it. You cannot pursue your own business. You cannot cook food or boil water. You cannot haul water, or carry loads through your gates — anything that wasn't set ready on Friday in your home is not allowed."

**2:32** "You cannot carry things between houses on that day. The sabbath is holier and more blessed than even the jubilee years. We angels kept this sabbath in heaven long before any human ever knew it existed on earth."

**2:33** "The Creator blessed this day. But he did not call all peoples and nations to observe it — only Israel. Israel alone was given the privilege of eating, drinking, and resting on the sabbath upon the earth."

---
*PNEUMA notes: "Dome" for firmament captures the ancient cosmology accessibly. The twenty-two number (vv.18,25) is kept but not explained in the text — it is a deliberate numerological signature of Jubilees. "Master clock" interprets sun's function (v.11) for modern readers.*
